program.title: Version 2B — 3D-previs pipeline (parallel to Version 2 and 2A)
notes: Parallel track beside Version 2 (data/v2_program.json phases 12–20) and Version 2A (data/v2a_program.json A0–A5). Do not edit those files from this track.
3D spec is the composition contract. Headless Blender AOVs → local ComfyUI ControlNet. Not sketch-first (that is 2A).
Image traffic is local ComfyUI or direct .env APIs. OmniRoute is text only. Never OmniRoute images.
Dashboard: /v2b reads this file. Architecture: /v2b/architecture. Source plan: /v2b/source-plan.
B0 is architecture only. No Blender or ComfyUI code until B1.
Test fixture is HIMYM Episode 1 (76 panels, longest V1 script). B1 proves panel 1 only.

b0.exit_gate: 2B is readable without running Blender or ComfyUI: docs/V2B_ARCHITECTURE.md + this JSON + /v2b; Version 2 and 2A untouched

b1.title: Vertical slice (Compass Phase 0)
b1.exit_gate: HIMYM ep1 panel 1 (living-room sofa, Dad + Maya) → Cycles blockout → one ComfyUI img2img PNG; same seed near-identical; ComfyUI over HTTP only. Do not render all 76 panels.
checklist: Create src/comicengine/v2b/ blender headless wrapper for data/v2b/episodes/ep01.json panel 1
Low-detail living room + two seated primitives (Dad, Maya); camera and lamp from the panel-1 spec
ComfyUI HTTP client (POST /prompt, ws progress, /history + /view)
pipeline.panel produces outputs/v2b/himym_ep01/panel_01.png with zero manual steps
Re-run with the same seed is byte-identical or near-identical on the Blender render
Do not use Blender MCP as the production path
Do not edit outputs/phase4/episode_how_i_met_your_mother_ep1.json from 2B work
notes: Commit when done: phase-v2b-b1: HIMYM ep1 panel 1 living-room two-shot through ComfyUI
Fixture is HIMYM ep1 (longest V1 episode, 76 panels). B1 is panel 1 only — not Aranya, not a nameless cube.

b2.title: AOVs + ControlNet (Compass Phase 1)
b2.exit_gate: Blender emits depth, normal, Freestyle, object-index; ComfyUI multi-ControlNet follows 3D geometry; structure SSIM(depth) floor on 3 test cameras
checklist: Configure Cycles AOVs: depth, normal, Freestyle as render pass, object-index
ComfyUI workflow JSON consumes depth + lineart (multi-ControlNet)
eval/structure re-extracts depth/edges vs conditioning
Visual check: camera/room match the 3D across 3 cameras
notes: Commit when done: phase-v2b-b2: Blender AOVs drive multi-ControlNet structure
Skip StableGen — custom ComfyUI graph only

b3.title: Style LoRA (Compass Phase 2)
b3.exit_gate: One style LoRA at fixed weight on every panel; locked checkpoint/sampler; style reads as intentional comic art, not default slop
checklist: Train or acquire one SDXL style LoRA; record hash in registry
Apply at fixed weight on every stylize call
Lock checkpoint, sampler, steps, CFG
Human gut-check across different scenes
notes: Commit when done: phase-v2b-b3: lock style LoRA on every 2B panel
SDXL OpenRAIL++-M is the ship base. Do not ship on FLUX.1-dev.

b4.title: Character LoRA bootstrap (Compass Phase 3)
b4.exit_gate: Turntable renders stylized (denoise ~0.4, ≥2 variants) then kohya SDXL LoRA; held-out cameras keep identity without baked-CG look
checklist: Render character turntable: many angles, poses, expressions, lights
Stylize each (img2img denoise ~0.4, ≥2 variants) before training
Train SDXL character LoRA (kohya); unique trigger token
Held-out camera eval with DINOv2/CLIP — not ArcFace as primary
Optional Gemini/fal bootstrap stylize stays direct .env keys, never OmniRoute
notes: Commit when done: phase-v2b-b4: bootstrap character LoRA from stylized 3D turntable
IP-Adapter/InstantID/PuLID are fallbacks only

b5.title: Location reuse (Compass Phase 4)
b5.exit_gate: Reusable versioned 3D locations; panel spec references location + character(s) + camera; four-axis scorecard per panel
checklist: Pydantic/YAML panel spec schema under data/v2b/
build_scene.py becomes spec-driven (not hardcoded)
Same location across multiple panels scored for background similarity
Full eval scorecard emitted per panel
notes: Commit when done: phase-v2b-b5: spec-driven locations with four-axis scorecards

b6.title: Multi-character masks (Compass Phase 5)
b6.exit_gate: Two+ character LoRAs in one panel gated by Blender object-index masks; own-identity holds, cross-identity below bleed threshold
checklist: Object-index / cryptomatte masks from Blender
Regional prompting / LoRA gating in ComfyUI
Two-pass masked inpaint fallback if single-pass bleeds
Bleed metric: own-identity vs other-identity
notes: Commit when done: phase-v2b-b6: mask-driven multi-character LoRAs without bleed

b7.title: Storyboard sequencing (Compass Phase 6)
b7.exit_gate: Storyboard spec produces a multi-panel sequence unattended; cache hits skip unchanged renders; cross-panel identity/location/style hold
checklist: pipeline/storyboard.py over an ordered panel spec
Content-hash cache for renders and conditioning maps
Shared characters/locations across the sequence
notes: Commit when done: phase-v2b-b7: multi-panel storyboard sequencing with cache

b8.title: Best-of-N eval (Compass Phase 7)
b8.exit_gate: N candidates per panel scored on structure/identity/location/lighting; auto-select agrees with human on a labeled set; low-confidence flags disagreements
checklist: Batch N candidates in ComfyUI (start N=4–8)
DINOv2/CLIP identity; depth/edge structure; VLM pairwise lighting
Hard thresholds then weighted rank; emit scorecard
Pairwise Qwen3-VL — not absolute 1–10 scores
notes: Commit when done: phase-v2b-b8: pairwise VLM best-of-N panel selection
Scorecards are the preference dataset for optional B9

b9.title: RL / DPO (Compass Phase 8, optional)
b9.exit_gate: Optional. Cloud Diffusion-DPO LoRA from accumulated best-of-N pairs; only after pairs exist and local 16GB is known not to fit
checklist: Do not start until a few thousand preference pairs exist
Rent cloud GPU (A100/H100); do not attempt DPO on 16GB
LoRA-only DPO on attention blocks first if attempted
notes: Commit if ever: phase-v2b-b9: optional cloud DPO from 2B preference pairs
Explicitly optional. Best-of-N with N≥8 may be enough.
